forbidden_inferences: a plugin manifest = a finished plugin system

gates.criterion: every cloud and local asset has SHA, authority, status and disposition; the history archive verifies
register / resolve / disable / health-check a capability without editing the Core; no plugin writes the database
gates.evidence: capability routes are launch-declared and the Core refuses an unknown worker
gates.to_advance: plugin registry, resolver surface, health, fallback

gates.criterion: each first-batch format reaches an Evidence anchor and a Knowledge object from a real file; one external source imports
gates.evidence: readiness 9 of 9 and real material 9 of 9 converted
gates.to_advance: software compatibility (Obsidian / Markdown folder / Git / Notion export) and cited ask/read

gates.criterion: a person answers in the product UI; the schedule is recorded; a restart reads the same state back
gates.evidence: the learning routes exist and the M0 chain shows FSRS plus restart readback, but driven by a probe
gates.to_advance: a real human at the real UI

gates.criterion: one real model runs on accepted knowledge; a human marks a real error; the correction is reviewed; a retest runs; nothing is auto-promoted
gates.evidence: a local model runtime is measured working, but no route drives it
gates.to_advance: the capability route that runs a real task and records a candidate

gates.criterion: the golden journey completes on a real file by a real person and a restart reads everything back

honest_note: No gate is claimed above TESTED_LOCAL or INTEGRATED. The single highest existing level anywhere in this project is 'tested locally with real inputs', and the matrix says so rather than rounding up.
